interface.shortDescription: Business intelligence, research and OS workflows
interface.longDescription: Hutchrok is the upstream business-intelligence and operating layer for formation, compliance, contracting, autonomous-business assessment, source-validated research, original content transformation, campaign scheduling and governed connected actions. It prioritizes authoritative sources for material claims, uses LinkedIn/YouTube and other media for discovery and market intelligence, preserves entity/account separation, and escalates new integrations or heavy engineering to Fee The Developer/Claude. Plays Ranch Programming remains the plugin distribution and endorsement layer.
defaultPrompt: Research this topic using authoritative sources and turn it into a Hutchrok content campaign.
Build a YouTube and LinkedIn rollout from these verified resources and prepare the publishing schedule.
Assess this opportunity for Hutchrok autonomy fit and give a GO/NO-GO recommendation.
